ATTACHED TABLE — Rules on the Imposition of Anti-Dumping Duties on Ferro-Silico-Manganese Originating in Vietnam and India

Anti-Dumping Duty Rates by Supplier of Goods Subject to Imposition (Related to Article 3)

Country of supply | Supplier | Anti-dumping duty rate (%)
Vietnam | 1. NRM (Hai Duong New Resources Metallurgy Shareholdings Company) and persons exporting that company's products | 2.30
Vietnam | 2. Other suppliers | 2.30
India | 3. Anjani (Anjaney Ferro Alloys Limited) and persons exporting that company's products | 11.04
India | 4. Maithan (Maithan Alloys Limited) and persons exporting that company's products | 11.04
India | 5. Indsil Energy (Indsil Energy and Electrochemicals Private Limited) and persons exporting that company's products | 11.04
India | 6. Indsil Hydro (Indsil Hydro Power and Manganese Limited) and persons exporting that company's products | 11.04
India | 7. Mortex (Mortex Group) and persons exporting that company's products | 11.04
India | 8. Other suppliers | 11.04

The original supplier names, eight categories and two country-specific rates are reproduced from the supplied Korean text. Completeness of the separately attached original table has not been independently verified.
